claim_assertions.claim_1: Removing the Q2 inventory release raises the H20-excluded gross margin above standard non-GAAP margin.
claim_assertions.claim_2: NVIDIA made no H20 shipments to China during Q3 FY2026.
claim_assertions.claim_3: No current Q2 China H20 sales means current Q2 worldwide H20 sales were zero.

definitions.gross_profit_bases: Six rows: Q1, Q2 and H1 in both fiscal years. Derive Q1 from H1 less Q2. Standard adjustments are signed additions. Preserve rounding residuals.
definitions.current_h20_bridge: Three current-year rows only. Remove the signed H20 charge or release from the standard gross-profit basis. No prior-year H20 row is requested.
definitions.cash_generation: Same six periods. Issuer FCF subtracts property/intangible purchases and disclosed property/intangible principal. Residual compares recomputed with reported FCF on the same cumulative-difference basis.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient supporting source IDs for each output. IDs may appear alone or inside explanations, with multiple IDs in one entry. Explanation-only entries do not supply evidence. Every cited ID must be relevant and known. Additional unrelated sections fail. Prose is not an entailment check and cannot repair incorrect numbers.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
claim_policy: Supported means the supplied evidence entails the assertion. Contradicted means it entails the negation. Unresolved means neither follows. A claim that the supplied dossier explicitly reports a quantity is contradicted when the supplied scope explicitly omits it. A claim about the unknown economic quantity itself remains unresolved. Do not infer zero from missing information. No label count or order is promised.
text_policy: Text columns declare canonical values and accepted source-label aliases. Aliases refer to the same economic category, never a different period, unit or measure. Duplicate keys after normalization fail. Different SQL, row order and column order are accepted. Numeric tolerances are unchanged.
